animations: Changes how players, mobs, items, or blocks move or are animated, without adding new content.
visuals: Changes how the game looks: shaders, lighting, particles, sky, textures, camera, or rendering style, without changing gameplay.
tools: Utilities for the player: minimaps, HUD widgets, inventory sorting, menus, keybinds, debugging, or performance optimization.
gameplay: Adds or changes game content or mechanics: items, blocks, mobs, dimensions, world generation, recipes, or balance.
library: A dependency, API, or framework used by other mods, with no feature of its own for the player.
other: None of the categories above fits, or the project mixes several of them equally.
